en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing a lively beach scene with people swimming, sunbathing, and walking along a long pier extending into the water. Several small sailboats and rowboats are visible on the water. The shoreline is lined with trees and large buildings, likely hotels or beach facilities, and a slightly hilly terrain appears in the background. The edges of the photo are scalloped, typical of early-to-mid 20th-century postcards. No visible text is present on the image side.
